mapper.select: select /* O.dhncorp.countAllBySearchParam */ count(1) as cnt from ${msg_table} where REQDTTM >= sysdate - 14 AND NVL(REQDTTM, sysdate) <= sysdate and TYPE = '${msg_type}' and STATUS = '100' and PRIORITY = '${priority}'
mapper.update: update /* O.dhncorp.updateGroupBySearchParam */ ${msg_table} set TYPE = '${group_no}' where REQDTTM >= sysdate - 14 AND NVL(REQDTTM, sysdate) <= sysdate and TYPE = '${msg_type}' and STATUS = '100' and PRIORITY = '${priority}' and ROWNUM <= 500
mapper.select: SELECT /* O.dhncorp.findAllBySearchParam */ SEQNO, 'AP' AS TYPE, MSG, MSG as MSG_SMS, CASE WHEN TYPE = 'P' THEN CASE WHEN LENGTHB(MSG) <= 90 THEN 'S' ELSE 'L' END ELSE '' END AS SMSKIND, CASE WHEN DESTNO LIKE '82%' THEN DESTNO WHEN DESTNO LIKE '010%' THEN '82' || SUBSTR(DESTNO, 2, 15) ELSE '82' || SUBSTR(DESTNO, 2, 15) END AS DESTNO, CALLBACK, BILLID, TITLE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGDT, KAKAO_CODE, CASE WHEN TYPE = 'P' OR TYPE = 'D' THEN '${profile_key}' ELSE '' END AS PROFILE_KEY, CASE WHEN REQDTTM IS NULL THEN '00000000000000' ELSE TO_CHAR(REQDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') END AS REQDTTM, PUSH_ID, APP_KEY, APP_SECRET, APP_LINK, ATCH_FILE_SN, APP_LAUNCH FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TYPE = '${group_no}'

SELECT /* O.dhncorp.findAllBySearchParam */ SEQNO, 'AT' as TYPE, MSG, MSG as MSG_SMS, CASE WHEN TYPE = 'T' THEN '' WHEN TYPE = 'K' THEN CASE WHEN LENGTHB(MSG) <= 90 THEN 'S' ELSE 'L' END END AS SMSKIND, CASE WHEN DESTNO LIKE '82%' THEN DESTNO WHEN DESTNO LIKE '010%' THEN '82' || SUBSTR(DESTNO, 2, 15) ELSE '82' || SUBSTR(DESTNO, 2, 15) END AS DESTNO, CALLBACK, BILLID, TITLE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGDT, KAKAO_CODE, '${profile_key}' AS PROFILE_KEY, CASE WHEN REQDTTM IS NULL THEN '00000000000000' ELSE TO_CHAR(REQDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') END AS REQDTTM FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TYPE = '${group_no}'

SELECT /* O.dhncorp.findAllBySearchParam */ SEQNO, 'PH' as TYPE, MSG, MSG as MSG_SMS, CASE WHEN LENGTHB(MSG) <= 90 THEN 'S' ELSE 'L' END AS SMSKIND, DESTNO, CALLBACK, BILLID, TITLE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGDT, CASE WHEN REQDTTM IS NULL THEN '00000000000000' ELSE TO_CHAR(REQDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') END AS REQDTTM FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TYPE = '${group_no}'
mapper.update: update /* O.dhncorp.updateDateMakeBySeqNO */ ${msg_table} set STATUS = '102' where TYPE = '${group_no}'
update /* O.dhncorp.updateSendFailBySearchParam */ ${msg_table} set STATUS = '100', TYPE = '${msg_type}' where TYPE = '${group_no}'
